title: Predictable tokens from rand() seeded by the clock
root_cause: srand(time(NULL)) seeds the pseudo-random generator with the current second. Anyone who can estimate when the token was generated only has to try each of that day's ~86,400 possible seeds to reproduce it exactly.
defenses: Never use rand(), random(), or any seeded PRNG for anything security-sensitive.
Use the operating system's cryptographic random source: getrandom() on Linux, arc4random_buf() on BSD/macOS.
For keys, tokens, nonces, and session IDs, go through a vetted crypto library (libsodium, OpenSSL), not raw OS calls, when the project already depends on one.
Audit every call site that currently uses rand()/srand() for a security purpose and replace it.
